description: This Zenodo archive contains subnational grain-sorghum production, harvested area and yield statistics for 2000–2020, with matching administrative-boundary shapefiles. Researchers compiled official national and subnational sources from eight countries spanning temperate to subtropical regions. The public repository lists one packaged release under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is those eight reporting countries, not a complete global crop census or a grid with field-scale observations. Administrative definitions, reporting completeness and changing national source methods are limitations for cross-country trend comparisons. A reviewer-assessed use is constraining food-supply or climate-adaptation simulations with historical sorghum production patterns. data-globalcropyield5min-1982-2015 is a related gridded crop-yield collection with different crop and time coverage; no harmonisation was verified. The GitHub project named in the article is an access and documentation route for the same dataset, not a separate draft. No archive or source table was downloaded.
